title: A ticked For Customer box sends the attachment to the payer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, with contact B1, marked Billing, whose email address you can read.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced, billed to customer B, with one file attached and marked For Customer.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the invoice's email (send) window on the Finance tab.
  3. Tick "Include 'For Customer' Attachments in email".
  4. Click Send.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The box is unticked and contact B1, customer B's Billing contact, is ticked.

Step 3:

  • The box is ticked.

Step 4:

  • The email arrives at contact B1 with the attached file.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12311 (Story 9, Invoice email to the Bill To)

  • S9-R4: “"For Customer" attachments behave as today: sent only when staff tick the box, which starts unticked.”
